pages.title: Naginata
pages.text: Naginata-type sword warriors. Sword warriors of the same type have basically no difference in attack speed, search range, attack power, and movement speed. Naginata can perform area-of-effect attacks. Unlike odachi, the area-of-effect attacks of naginata deal full damage.

pages.name: Tomoegata Naginata
pages.text: A naginata with a wide, deeply curved blade, considered to be used for ceremonial purposes. Possessing a high divine nature, his awareness as a human is relatively weak. He can sometimes be overly protective of his master. He always stands on the side of the saniwa and enjoys taking care of them.
